name: Analyze Protease Kinetics
description: Analyze protease kinetics data from fluorogenic peptide cleavage assays, fit the data to Michaelis-Menten kinetics, and determine key kinetic parameters.
detailed_description: Analyze protease kinetics data from fluorogenic peptide cleavage assays, fit the data to Michaelis-Menten kinetics, and determine key kinetic parameters.
when_to_use: When you need analyze protease kinetics analysis

parameters.time_points: [Required] Array of time points (in seconds) at which measurements were taken (numpy.ndarray)
parameters.fluorescence_data: [Required] 2D array of fluorescence measurements where each row corresponds to a different substrate concentration and each column corresponds to a time point (numpy.ndarray)
parameters.substrate_concentrations: [Required] Array of substrate concentrations (in μM) corresponding to each row in fluorescence_data (numpy.ndarray)
parameters.enzyme_concentration: [Required] Concentration of the protease enzyme (in μM) (float)
